PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # diff pair L
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # PMOS mirror / CS stage gm/Id (matched for systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # PMOS mirror / CS L
    "gmidb": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # NMOS bias mirrors gm/Id
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
    "Itail": (8e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),    # preamp tail current
    "I2":    (6e-6, 2e-6, 9e-6),     # gain-stage current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]

    # ---- bias: ibias diode + mirrors (same gm/Id and L, scaled current) ----
    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mt  = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7  = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # ---- preamp: NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror load ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.55, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=1.0)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)

    # ---- gain stage: PMOS CS, same current density as the mirror (balanced at Vid=0) ----
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # Diode side on vinn: vinp up -> o1 down -> o2 up -> o3 down -> vout up.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # Rail-to-rail buffer: two CMOS inverters (no static current once o2 sits at a rail)
    n.M("MI1N", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.5, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.5, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.5, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 4.5, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order performance predictions ----
    gout1 = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A1 = m1.gm / gout1
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    cinv1 = (0.5 * 0.15 + 1.5 * 0.15) * 1e-14
    cinv2 = (1.5 * 0.15 + 4.5 * 0.15) * 1e-14
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m6.cgg + 2 * m6.cgd
    tau1 = C1 / gout1
    t1 = tau1 * math.log(2) * 1.5
    C2 = m6.cdd + m7.cdd + cinv1 + m6.cgd
    t2 = C2 * 0.9 / I2
    t3 = (cinv2 + 2e-15) * 0.9 / (0.5 * 100e-6) + (cl + 3e-15) * 0.9 / (1.5 * 100e-6)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd,
        "power": power,
        "polarity_ok": 1,
        "offset": 0.0,
        "gain1_db": db(A1),
        "gain2_db": db(A2),
        "tail_vds_margin": 0.9 - m1.vgs - mt.vdsat,
    }
